move: pill tears into stepper and View cart, quantity rolls on taps, merges back
how: A dark product panel rises in with expo.out over the first 8% of the 8s loop; a white 404px 'Add to cart' pill sits at the bottom with two hidden duplicate pills stacked under it. Cursor glides in and taps at 1.35s (17%): the pill dips scale 0.92, springs with elastic.out(1,0.45) and a ring ripple expands. At 1.52s the whole pill hides and the two duplicates split: the left shrinks to 172px and the right shrinks to 218px while sliding x 186, both expo.out 0.7s, so the pill visibly tears in two. A minus/qty/plus stepper fades into the left with its buttons popping from scale 0.6 with back.out(2.5) staggered, the quantity column rolls y 0 to -30 with back.out(1.6), and 'View cart' with an arrow settles into the right from x 12. Two plus taps (3.2s, 3.9s) and one minus tap (5.1s) roll the digit column by 30px each with the same press/ring/elastic. The cursor hovers View cart and its arrow nudges, then at 7.0s (87.5%) both pills expand back to 404px with expo.inOut, the whole pill and label fade back in and the digit column resets, while the cursor exits.
adapt: Change product name, price, thumb gradient, the widths (172 / 218 / 404) and the tap count; PLUS_X / MINUS_X depend on the left pill width. Keep the 0.7s expo.out tear and 0.4s back.out(1.6) digit roll.
port: mount(el, shot) builds glow, panel (row, btnwrap with three pills), ring and cursor inside el. animate returns the timeline with the click() helper emitting press/ring/elastic at fractions of D (split tap 0.169D, split 0.19D, plus taps 0.4D and 0.4875D, minus 0.6375D, merge 0.875D). Stage coords BX/BY/PLUS_X/MINUS_X must be recomputed from the pill's offset within el; the .from() on the panel needs immediateRender:false.
caveats: panel entry uses from() and never exits, so the last frame keeps the panel while the first fades it in
width tweens on the pills trigger layout each frame
cursor targets are hard-coded stage coordinates
